QUERY PLAN
----------------------------------------------------
Hash Join  (cost=100.00..200.00 rows=1000 width=16)
  Hash Cond: (a.id = b.id)
  ->  Seq Scan on table_a  (cost=0.00..50.00 rows=500 width=8)
  ->  Hash  (cost=30.00..30.00 rows=500 width=8)
        ->  Seq Scan on table_b  (cost=0.00..30.00 rows=500 width=8)
